svg.title: OpenDART CI · GitHub Actions workflows
svg.desc: Pull requests, pushes to main, and manual runs start ci.yml. Its first job selects checks from the changed files; the selected check workflows feed the required CI checks gate. On main, a passing gate publishes the MCP image when its inputs change, and API changes run live contract tests. Release tags promote the published image. Weekly audits and a daily scan of the published image run on schedules.
svg.text: Path filters in .github/ci-paths.toml choose the checks · every step runs a just recipe
